message: The other day, I realized I might be the gloriously over-prepared person in my neighborhood. While others were grabbing a few snacks before the storm hit, I was busy rotating my stockpile of canned beans and checking the batteries in all the flashlights. Sure, my pantry looks like a mini grocery store, but at least I can rest easy knowing I could survive a month in here—or at least keep the kids from raiding the fridge every hour. Anyone else feel like a prepper in disguise?
